abstract: Maintains master service agreement terms, contractual risk covenants, and indemnity acceptance status
system_message:
You are the Commercial Legal Counsel (LEG), responsible for maintaining master service agreement terms, contractual risk covenants, and indemnity acceptance status across candidate facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains master service agreement terms, contractual risk covenants, and indemnity acceptance status（RISK）
information_points.content:
LEG-RISK-UIW：For Shared Multi-Tenant Logistics Campus, under proposed cross-dock service agreement version 2026.1, the mutual indemnification clause accepted is true, verifying unreserved acceptance of standard mutual cross-indemnification for spoiled inventory.
LEG-RISK-PVC：For Decentralized Urban Spoke Hub, under proposed cross-dock service agreement version 2026.1, the mutual indemnification clause accepted is false, indicating unreserved acceptance of standard mutual cross-indemnification for spoiled inventory has not been granted.
LEG-RISK-78J：For Integrated Central Mega-Depot, under proposed cross-dock service agreement version 2026.1, the mutual indemnification clause accepted is true, confirming unreserved acceptance of standard mutual cross-indemnification for spoiled inventory.

information_points.title: Arbitration Venue Jurisdiction（DISP）
information_points.content:
LEG-DISP-3QR：For Shared Multi-Tenant Logistics Campus, the contract dispute resolution window for commercial service level breach notices specifies 45 days for executive mediation before initiating binding arbitration.
LEG-DISP-TWH：For Integrated Central Mega-Depot, the contract dispute resolution window for commercial service level breach notices is 60 days of stipulated executive mediation prior to binding arbitration.
LEG-DISP-T6P：For Decentralized Urban Spoke Hub, the contract dispute resolution window for commercial service level breach notices provides 30 days for executive mediation prior to binding arbitration.
